create_memory_run_store: create a MemoryRunStore instance to manage in-memory run records with an internal dictionary
put_run_record: store a new run record with run_id, thread_id, status, metadata, and optional assistant or user ids
get_run_by_id: retrieve a stored run record by its run_id from the in-memory store
list_runs_by_thread: list runs filtered by thread_id with optional user_id filter and result limit sorted by creation time
aggregate_tokens_by_thread: aggregate token usage statistics by model and caller type for completed runs in a given thread
